en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Dukadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (6) 18.14.
Cūḷantaraduka, Hetuduka.

Dependent on a conditioned state that is not a root-cause (*na-hetu*), a state that is neither non-conditioned nor a root-cause arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. One [formula] under root-condition; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a conditioned state that is not a root-cause, a state that is neither non-conditioned nor a root-cause arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One under root-condition; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance condition. (The constructed [section] is the same as the conditioned [section].)

Dependent on a non-indicative, non-causal state, there arises a non-indicative, non-causal state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under object condition there is one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a non-indicative, non-causal state, there arises a non-non-indicative, non-causal state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there is one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there is one.

Dependent on a non-reactive (appaṭigha) state that is not a root-cause (nahetu), there arises a non-reactive state that is not a root-cause by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition there are three; under the object-condition, one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a non-reactive state that is not a root-cause, there arises a non-reactive state that is not a root-cause by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition there is one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, one.

Dependent on a non-material, non-root-cause state, a non-material, non-root-cause state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; one for object … pe … three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a material, non-root-cause state, a non-material, non-root-cause state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-material, non-root-cause state, a non-material, non-root-cause state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to root condition: three; with respect to object condition: three; with respect to predominance condition: one … pe … with respect to prenascence and repetition conditions: one … pe … with respect to non-disappearance condition: three.
Dependent on a mundane state that is a root, a supramundane state that is not a root arises by way of root condition … one.

Dependent on a supramundane state that is a root, a mundane state that is not a root arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated. With respect to root condition: four; with respect to object condition: two … pe … with respect to non-disappearance condition: four.
Dependent on a mundane state that is not a cause, there arises a supramundane state that is not a cause by way of root condition … one.

Dependent on a supramundane state that is not a cause, there arises a mundane state that is not a cause by way of root condition … one. … [Under] root [condition] there are two … [and so on] … [under] non-disappearance [condition] there are two.
Dependent on a state that is cognizable by something and is a cause, there arises a state that is not cognizable by anything and is not a cause by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state cognizable by some [consciousness] that is a root-cause, there arises a state not cognizable by any [consciousness] that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state cognizable by some [consciousness] that is a root-cause and a state not cognizable by any [consciousness] that is a root-cause, there arises a state not cognizable by any [consciousness] that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated. Nine for root … pe … nine for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state cognizable by any [consciousness] and not-root-conditioned, there arises a state cognizable by no [consciousness] and not-root-conditioned, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
